data.one_liner: A wrapper widget that resizes a child Navigator to match its current route's content size.
data.what_it_does: NavigatorResizable wraps a Navigator and automatically adjusts its size to fit the dimensions of the active route's widget tree. It works with standard Navigator APIs and other routing packages like go_router or auto_route.
use_when: You need a Navigator that shrinks or grows based on the content of each route
Embedding a Navigator inside a constrained layout (e.g., Dialog, BottomSheet) where size should adapt
avoid_when: You require unbounded size for the Navigator (e.g., full-screen routes)
Performance‑critical apps where extra layout passes may be costly
strengths: Eliminates manual size calculations for nested navigators
Works with existing navigation APIs and popular routing packages
Handles edge‑case transitions and predictive back gestures
weaknesses: Requires bounded constraints; will assert in debug if parent provides unbounded size
Adds an extra widget layer which may affect performance in very complex hierarchies

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides full routing features including nested navigation without needing a separate resizing wrapper
